results.title: Lone Star Bull
results.overview: Bull Jackson is a bouncer in a gay bar where Jordan performs as a drag queen by night and is a medical student by day. When Coco, their mentor and owner of the club, is shot in what appears to be a random homophobic attack, Bull and Jordan form an unlikely team to find those responsible.

results.title: Latir
results.overview: Chile, 2022. During the constitutional plebiscite in Chile, Manuel, a retired university professor, takes part in a body percussion workshop that profoundly transforms his life and helps him cope with his wife’s terminal illness.

results.title: Krampus in Space
results.overview: A salvage crew finds a relic box on an abandoned ship. Opening it unleashes Krampus, an ancient predator now stalking their vessel. With the creature picking them off, the crew races to decode the relic's origins before their mission-and their lives-are swallowed by the darkness they unleashed.

results.title: Theatre from Mud
results.overview: On the 45th anniversary of the Grange Theatre in Vojvodina, its two legendary founders - director György Hernyák and actor Frigyes Kovács - have reunited. It was a unique occasion seeing these two masters create art under the open sky once again. Through this rehearsal process, the documentary draws a vivid portrait of the Grange Theatre’s past and present, the community built around it, and the unique energy that binds Vojvodina Hungarian identity with the troupe’s history. The film is not merely a retrospective; it reveals how liberating and life-affirming theater-making can be, and how the joy of free creation remains indispensable today.

results.title: Underland
results.overview: Adapted from Robert Macfarlane's bestselling book, this mesmerising documentary journeys into worlds seldom seen by human eyes.

results.title: Under a Bamboo Sky
results.overview: A tale of human connection, hope and resilience in the face of great tragedy, Under a Bamboo Sky uses new technology to bring to life an untold story of Australian soldiers held prisoner by the Japanese in WWII. Using their own words, their own voices, the film weaves the recollections of more than 60 former POWs with newly colourised archival material and new location footage to deliver a moving and revelatory first-hand account of their experience. Captured during the Japanese offensive and imprisoned in Singapore’s Changi Barracks, the film follows the years long journey of these soldiers through four countries. After bearing witness to some of WWII’s most history-defining events, they tell of returning home to families, wives and sweethearts, and of the price they paid for the trauma they endured. Shining through the horrors of war is the spirit of these men and an inspiring human capacity to find beauty in their surroundings and hold onto hope in the worst of circumstances.

results.title: The Waiting Man
results.overview: In 2022, the famous streaming group TOMNI was at the height of its popularity with over 7 million followers. Over the course of a week, their content changed and then they suddenly vanished. This is the footage recovered from their social media, computers, and SD cards. Experts believe the footage shows the worldwide phenomenon known as Alikabiha, also called the Waiting Man.

results.title: Mercy Killing a Rat
results.overview: Follow a young man as he discovers what it truly means to take the life of another living being.

results.title: Evolver 62
results.overview: Globally-renowned historian Mark Lewisohn weaves an array of short, sharp stories into a savvy and surprising reveal of a band that's remained both cutting-edge and massively popular. Drawing from his extraordinary archive, Lewisohn zips through a galaxy of real lives and times, weaving curated artifacts into an entertaining narrative. Celebrating The Beatles' seminal year — 1962, the year that changed everything — the film explores the band's evolution through the very places and artifacts that shaped their story. Extending his celebrated stage show, Lewisohn takes the camera out of the theatre and onto the streets of Liverpool and London, to the sites where history unfolded. A compelling, surprising, and unmissable treat, EVOLVER:62 delivers unique viewing for Beatles fans, music lovers, and anyone curious about the moments that reshaped modern culture.

results.title: 300th Episode of Rince-Crème
results.overview: It is a big night, the night of the 300th Rince-Crème episode. With special guests, surprises and a lot of love for you, our fans.

results.title: The Surveyor
results.overview: An eager young surveyor takes her first solo job: a quiet, empty field. Routine. Nothing to it. Starring Chloe Breen (Obsession) and Michael Paré (Streets of Fire).

results.title: Tsume Kill: The Clapper Claw
results.overview: A struggling beauty streamer receives a mysterious nail gel and soon discovers that her growing nails have developed a violent life of their own.

results.title: The Prince of Nanawa
results.overview: On a bustling footbridge separating Argentina and Paraguay, where people traffic all kinds of things in a mix of Guarani and Spanish, we meet Angel. Over the course of the next ten years, Angel will have to make decisive choices for his future.

results.title: I is another
results.overview: In the heart of a ravine far from the city, a young soccer player flees from someone stalking him. When he finds himself with no way out, he is fatally wounded, causing his consciousness to split just before he dies.

results.title: The Mole Must Die
results.overview: In the late Chongzhen reign, Heyang County was flooded with corrupt officials, when the Imperial Guards suddenly descended to conduct a thorough crackdown. Spies from rival factions infiltrated the county and vied against one another, and the unspoken catchphrase among all was "All spies must die." Zhao Renbao, a minor local clerk, realizes every powerful figure intends to use him as a pawn. Determined to take control of his fate, he devises an elaborate trap within a trap of his own, outwitting corrupt nobles and officials amid the razor-thin line between life and death.

results.title: Somewhere Between Sleep
results.overview: Anke is about to leave her small German town in the Black Forest region, while Lisa finds it hard to feel at home there. They meet by chance on a cold, grey autumn day, and wander the streets together.

results.title: 21 d’octubre
results.overview: A Special Forces police team (Special Intervention Group) is sent to a movie theater where a shooting is taking place. Things get even more complicated when Pedro, the team leader, begins to believe that his son Mateo might be inside the theater.

results.title: Ray Comfort's Inferno
results.overview: A found footage movie collage of various Hells throughout Christian cinema. It is tied together and wrapped around with clips of Ray Comfort. A mediation on the concept and presentation of hell with the help of special guest Mr. Bean.

results.title: Back In the Game
results.overview: Eight years ago, Jiale, a senior member in the gang, takes the blame for his brother and goes to prison. After his release, he wants to live peacefully in a small coastal town, away from the underworld. However, his former boss, Rong, intends to hand over the gang to him, while Huoshan, who rose to power thanks to Jiale's sacrifice, sees his return as a huge threat. As power, lies, and old grudges intertwine, Jiale has no choice but to return to the underworld. Along the way, he saves Jiehe, a girl with a music dream on the verge of despair, and she becomes a glimmer of light in his dark life. To protect the ones he cherishes and account for his past, he picks up the knife again. A thrilling gunfight breaks out in the dark alleys of the city, and he turns the tables time and again with his skills. Tearing off Huoshan's disguise, the truth from eight years ago comes to light.
